title: Exploration of the potential common pathogenic mechanisms in COVID-19 and silicosis by using bioinformatics and system biology.
authors: Tian, Yunze; Yu, Beibei; Zhang, Yongfeng; Zhang, Sanpeng; Lv, Boqiang; Gong, Shouping; Li, Jianzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析COVID-19与矽肺的共享分子机制，虽涉及转录因子调控和分子对接，但核心是疾病关联基因表达分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模与AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Silicosis is an occupational lung disease that is common worldwide. In recent years, coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) has provided daunting challenges to public healthcare systems globally. Although multiple studies have shown a close link between COVID-19 and other respiratory diseases, the inter-relational mechanisms between COVID-19 and silicosis remain unclear. This study aimed to explore the shared molecular mechanisms and drug targets of COVID-19 and silicosis. Gene expression profiling identified four modules that were most closely associated with both diseases. Furthermore, we performed functional analysis and constructed a protein-protein interaction network. Seven hub genes (budding uninhibited by benzimidazoles 1 [BUB1], protein regulator of cytokinesis 1 [PRC1], kinesin family member C1 [KIFC1], ribonucleotide reductase regulatory subunit M2 [RRM2], cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 3 [CDKN3], Cyclin B2 [CCNB2], and minichromosome maintenance complex component 6 [MCM6]) were involved in the interaction between COVID-19 and silicosis. We investigated how diverse microRNAs and transcription factors regulate these seven genes. Subsequently, the correlation between the hub genes and infiltrating immune cells was explored. Further in-depth analyses were performed based on single-cell transcriptomic data from COVID-19, and the expression of hub-shared genes was characterized and located in multiple cell clusters. Finally, molecular docking results reveal small molecular compounds that may improve COVID-19 and silicosis. The current study reveals the common pathogenesis of COVID-19 and silicosis, which may provide a novel reference for further research.
abstract_zh: 矽肺是一种全球常见的职业性肺部疾病。近年来，2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）对全球公共卫生系统构成了严峻挑战。尽管多项研究表明COVID-19与其他呼吸系统疾病之间存在密切联系，但COVID-19与矽肺之间的相互关系机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探索COVID-19与矽肺的共同分子机制和药物靶点。基因表达谱分析识别出与这两种疾病最密切相关的四个模块。此外，我们进行了功能分析并构建了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。七个核心基因（苯并咪唑类抑制出芽1 [BUB1]、细胞因子调节蛋白1 [PRC1]、驱动蛋白家族成员C1 [KIFC1]、核糖核苷酸还原酶调节亚基M2 [RRM2]、细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶抑制剂3 [CDKN3]、细胞周期蛋白B2 [CCNB2]和微小染色体维持复合物组分6 [MCM6]）参与了COVID-19与矽肺之间的相互作用。我们研究了多种微小RNA和转录因子如何调控这七个基因。随后，探讨了核心基因与浸润免疫细胞之间的相关性。基于COVID-19的单细胞转录组数据进行了进一步深入分析，并表征了共享核心基因的表达及其在多个细胞簇中的定位。最后，分子对接结果揭示了可能改善COVID-19和矽肺的小分子化合物。当前研究揭示了COVID-19与矽肺的共同发病机制，这可能为进一步研究提供新的参考。
